vectors.purpose: Accept the canonical pytest #4412 acquisition-run identity lexeme.
vectors.rationale: Run identity is an opaque lowercase ASCII lexeme, never a parsed structure.

vectors.purpose: Accept the shortest permitted acquisition-run identity.
vectors.rationale: A single lowercase alphanumeric character satisfies the boundary grammar.

vectors.purpose: Accept the 160-character upper bound for run identity.
vectors.rationale: The inclusive maximum length is contractual and must not silently shrink.

vectors.purpose: Accept the smallest run-local request ordinal.
vectors.rationale: Ordinals are one-based and run-local, never global identity.

vectors.purpose: Accept the inclusive maximum request ordinal.
vectors.rationale: The declared ordinal ceiling is contractual.

vectors.purpose: Accept a composite request identity from explicit JSON.
vectors.rationale: Request identity is exactly acquisition run plus run-local ordinal.

vectors.purpose: Accept the same composite identity from strictly typed Python input.
vectors.rationale: Python input requires already-typed components with no coercion.

vectors.purpose: Accept the shortest origin-relative route path.
vectors.rationale: A route path is origin-relative and begins with exactly one slash.

vectors.purpose: Accept the canonical compare route path.
vectors.rationale: Route paths carry no query or fragment and are not normalized.

vectors.purpose: Accept a route path with exact two-digit percent escapes.
vectors.rationale: Percent escapes are preserved exactly and never decoded.

vectors.purpose: Accept complete retrieval provenance for one identified request.
vectors.rationale: Authority, method, route, and start time are provenance, not identity.

vectors.purpose: Accept the explicit +00:00 asserted-UTC form and normalize its rendering.
vectors.rationale: Asserted UTC accepts Z and +00:00 while semantic output stays canonical.

vectors.purpose: Accept the same provenance record from strictly typed Python input.
vectors.rationale: Support types cross the module boundary already validated.

vectors.purpose: Accept the canonical requested media type.
vectors.rationale: Media types use token/token grammar without parameters or wildcards.

vectors.purpose: Accept the shortest permitted media type.
vectors.rationale: The three-character minimum is contractual.

vectors.purpose: Accept the canonical GitHub API version lexeme.
vectors.rationale: API versions are exact opaque lexemes, never parsed dates.

vectors.purpose: Accept a non-date API-version lexeme.
vectors.rationale: No numeric or chronological interpretation is applied.

vectors.purpose: Accept a bare flag parameter with no delimiter.
vectors.rationale: `flag` and `flag=` are contractually distinct observations.

vectors.purpose: Accept an empty-valued parameter that retains its delimiter.
vectors.rationale: Delimiter presence is preserved separately from the value.

vectors.purpose: Accept an ordinary valued query parameter.
vectors.rationale: A nonempty value requires an explicit delimiter.

vectors.purpose: Accept exact percent-encoded query text.
vectors.rationale: Query components are never decoded or normalized.

vectors.purpose: Accept ordered query parameters including a repeated name.
vectors.rationale: Order and duplicate names are exact observations, not a mapping.

vectors.purpose: Accept controls with no query and no API version.
vectors.rationale: Absent API version is explicit `None`, never an empty string.

vectors.purpose: Accept an observed query delimiter that carried no parameters.
vectors.rationale: A trailing `?` is a real observation distinct from no delimiter.

vectors.purpose: Accept request controls from strictly typed Python input.
vectors.rationale: Python input requires an exact tuple of already-typed parameters.

vectors.purpose: Accept the lowest protocol-defined status code.
vectors.rationale: Status codes are exact three-digit protocol values.

vectors.purpose: Accept the highest protocol-defined status code.
vectors.rationale: The inclusive 100-599 range is contractual.

vectors.purpose: Accept an ordinary content-encoding token.
vectors.rationale: Content encodings use ASCII HTTP token grammar.

vectors.purpose: Accept the identity content-encoding token.
vectors.rationale: Identity is an observation, not an absence of encoding.

vectors.purpose: Accept an observed media-type parameter.
vectors.rationale: Media parameters stay separate from the media type itself.

vectors.purpose: Accept an observed media parameter with an empty value.
vectors.rationale: An empty parameter value is a real observation.

vectors.purpose: Accept a complete observed response representation.
vectors.rationale: Observed media differs from requested media and stays separate.

vectors.purpose: Accept an unavailable representation with unknown optional metadata.
vectors.rationale: Unknown components are `None` rather than fabricated defaults.

vectors.purpose: Accept known-empty media-parameter and encoding collections.
vectors.rationale: Known empty differs from unknown at the observation level.

vectors.purpose: Accept an inaccessible representation carrying only a status code.
vectors.rationale: Inaccessible is a distinct state from unavailable and unknown.

vectors.purpose: Accept an observation built from strictly typed Python components.
vectors.rationale: Encoding chains must be exact tuples of typed values in Python input.

vectors.purpose: Accept the canonical compare-diff digest scope.
vectors.rationale: Digest scope names the exact bytes a digest covers.

vectors.purpose: Accept the canonical Git blob-content digest scope.
vectors.rationale: Blob content and HTTP entity bodies are different digest scopes.

vectors.purpose: Accept the exact retained compare-diff digest.
vectors.rationale: Digests are exact lowercase 64-character hexadecimal lexemes.

vectors.purpose: Accept the exact retained historical LICENSE digest.
vectors.rationale: The historical third-party blob digest is an immutable source fact.

vectors.purpose: Accept a zero-length exact artifact.
vectors.rationale: An empty retained body is a legitimate exact observation.

vectors.purpose: Accept the exact retained compare-diff byte length.
vectors.rationale: Byte length is an exact source fact, never an estimate.

vectors.purpose: Accept the inclusive maximum artifact byte length.
vectors.rationale: The declared ceiling is contractual and must not silently shrink.

vectors.purpose: Accept an algorithm-, scope-, and value-qualified digest claim.
vectors.rationale: A digest is meaningless without its explicit scope.

vectors.purpose: Accept a digest claim from strictly typed Python input.
vectors.rationale: Python input rejects bare strings for typed digest components.

vectors.purpose: Accept the canonical compare-diff artifact identity.
vectors.rationale: Content identity is digest plus exact byte length, with no payload.

vectors.purpose: Accept the canonical historical LICENSE artifact identity.
vectors.rationale: The retained third-party blob is identified without embedding bytes.

vectors.purpose: Accept a clearly synthetic artifact identity.
vectors.rationale: Synthetic identities exercise shape without claiming a source fact.

vectors.purpose: Accept the request-linked compare-diff retention record.
vectors.rationale: Retention links one request identity to one exact artifact identity.

vectors.purpose: Accept the request-linked historical LICENSE retention record.
vectors.rationale: Exact unmodified bytes is the only supported retention mode.

vectors.purpose: Accept a membership whose optional evidence is entirely unknown.
vectors.rationale: `None` means unrepresented, never known-empty.

vectors.purpose: Accept a membership with a known-empty artifact inventory.
vectors.rationale: `()` records that no artifact was retained, unlike `None`.

vectors.purpose: Accept a fully populated membership for the retained compare diff.
vectors.rationale: Every optional component must agree with the membership request identity.

vectors.purpose: Accept a membership with typed Python components and known-empty artifacts.
vectors.rationale: An empty Python tuple stays known-empty rather than becoming `None`.

vectors.purpose: Accept a terminal run with no requests at all.
vectors.rationale: Terminal status never implies historical completeness.

vectors.purpose: Accept a partial terminal run with one member.
vectors.rationale: Partial and complete are terminal status, not completeness assessment.

vectors.purpose: Accept nondecreasing present request start times inside the run window.
vectors.rationale: Chronology is checked only across present references.

vectors.purpose: Accept the canonical 32-request pytest #4412 acquisition run.
vectors.rationale: Two retained artifacts and thirty known-empty inventories are exact facts.

vectors.purpose: Accept the canonical acquisition record format identifier.
vectors.rationale: Record formats are lowercase hyphenated internal identifiers.

vectors.purpose: Accept the canonical S04.C01 addendum format identifier.
vectors.rationale: A correction record carries its own distinct format identity.

vectors.purpose: Accept the canonical record version lexeme.
vectors.rationale: Versions are exact lexemes with no numeric interpretation.

vectors.purpose: Accept a mixed dotted version lexeme.
vectors.rationale: Dots, hyphens, and underscores are permitted interior characters.

vectors.purpose: Accept the declared byte convention of the referenced durable record.
vectors.rationale: This names the referenced record's bytes, not an envelope byte format.

vectors.purpose: Accept a synthetic declared canonicalization identifier.
vectors.rationale: The field is an opaque declaration, never an executable serializer.

vectors.purpose: Accept the canonical acquisition durable-record reference.
vectors.rationale: References are content-addressed and carry no path or storage locator.

vectors.purpose: Accept the canonical S04.C01 correction durable-record reference.
vectors.rationale: The correction record is referenced separately from its target.

vectors.purpose: Accept the acquisition reference from strictly typed Python input.
vectors.rationale: Every component must already be its declared root type.

vectors.purpose: Accept the canonical S04.C01 relationship identifier.
vectors.rationale: Relationship identity is an opaque internal lexeme.

vectors.purpose: Accept a dotted omission identifier lexeme.
vectors.rationale: Dots and underscores are permitted interior characters.

vectors.purpose: Accept a descriptive transformation operation identifier.
vectors.rationale: Operations are descriptive labels that are never executed.

vectors.purpose: Accept a single-token transformation operation identifier.
vectors.rationale: The grammar permits a bare lowercase token.

vectors.purpose: Accept an exact-artifact transformation subject.
vectors.rationale: An artifact subject carries an identity and no record reference.

vectors.purpose: Accept a durable-record transformation subject.
vectors.rationale: A record subject carries a reference and no artifact identity.

vectors.purpose: Accept a synthetic lossless reversible transformation.
vectors.rationale: Positive transformation behavior is only ever synthetic in this corpus.

vectors.purpose: Accept a lossy irreversible transformation carrying a parameter record.
vectors.rationale: Lossiness and reversibility are explicit, never inferred from operation.

vectors.purpose: Accept ordered multiple inputs with unknown classification.
vectors.rationale: Unknown is an explicit classification rather than a missing value.

vectors.purpose: Accept the canonical S04.C01 additive correction edge.
vectors.rationale: Correction preserves both the historical target and the correction.

vectors.purpose: Accept a synthetic additive correction edge.
vectors.rationale: Shape coverage does not require asserting an additional source fact.

vectors.purpose: Accept a synthetic supersession edge.
vectors.rationale: Supersession is distinct from correction and is only synthetic here.

vectors.purpose: Accept a supersession edge from strictly typed Python input.
vectors.rationale: Both endpoints must already be durable-record references.

vectors.purpose: Resolve the canonical correction through the typed relationship union.
vectors.rationale: The union discriminates on relationship_kind without guessing.

vectors.purpose: Resolve a synthetic supersession through the typed relationship union.
vectors.rationale: Both union members remain reachable and exactly typed.

vectors.purpose: Accept the same relationship-ID lexeme under two distinct typed kinds.
vectors.rationale: Relationship identity is the pair of kind and lexeme, not the lexeme.

vectors.purpose: Accept the canonical declared retention scope identifier.
vectors.rationale: Completeness is always relative to one explicitly declared scope.

vectors.purpose: Accept a minimal scope identifier lexeme.
vectors.rationale: Scope identity is an opaque bounded lexeme.

vectors.purpose: Accept the canonical retained compare-diff requirement identifier.
vectors.rationale: Requirement identity uses underscores from the declared scope.

vectors.purpose: Accept the canonical final omitted requirement identifier.
vectors.rationale: Omitted requirement identities remain explicit and enumerable.

vectors.purpose: Accept the canonical declared-retention-policy reason code.
vectors.rationale: Reason codes are bounded lowercase hyphenated lexemes.

vectors.purpose: Accept a synthetic disposition reason code.
vectors.rationale: Reason vocabulary is open but syntactically bounded.

vectors.purpose: Accept the canonical intentional omission for issue body prose.
vectors.rationale: Omissions cite the exact durable records that declare them.

vectors.purpose: Accept a synthetic unsupported omission.
vectors.rationale: All five omission outcomes share one structured disposition record.

vectors.purpose: Accept the permitted shape for the intentionally_omitted outcome.

vectors.purpose: Accept the canonical acquisition publication provenance record.

vectors.purpose: Accept a legacy-only envelope with every modern component unrepresented.
vectors.rationale: Legacy v1 values stay unchanged behind the outer wrapper.

vectors.purpose: Accept a modern envelope carrying only the canonical acquisition run.
vectors.rationale: Modern evidence never fabricates a legacy snapshot.

vectors.purpose: Accept a standalone request membership outside any acquisition run.
vectors.rationale: Standalone membership is a distinct representation from run membership.

vectors.purpose: Accept a mix of known-empty and unrepresented component inventories.
vectors.rationale: `()` and `None` remain contractually different at envelope level.

vectors.rationale: Composition never reinterprets the already-typed member records.

vectors.purpose: Accept the canonical current pytest #4412 evidence envelope.
vectors.rationale: One run, zero transformations, one correction, one assessment, two publications.

vectors.purpose: Accept a lossless legacy wrapping result.
vectors.rationale: Wrapping is lossless only when no modern component is represented.

vectors.purpose: Accept a lossless projection result for a legacy-only envelope.
vectors.rationale: The projected snapshot is the exact preserved legacy value.

vectors.purpose: Accept a fail-closed projection result for a modern-only envelope.
vectors.rationale: No legacy snapshot may ever be fabricated from modern evidence.
